region.why: a deployment fact: HCAZERRS ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; the corpus names no region

notes: The example-health-apis visit reader HCIVDB01, LINKed with a COMMAREA: after the length checks it builds a DB2 timestamp from CA-VISIT-DATE and CA-VISIT-TIME and SELECTs the BLOODPRESSURE then the HEARTRATE row. Tables come from the estate's @DB2CRE.jcl (HCZMSA1). scenarios.name: found
scenarios.why: BLOODPRESSURE for patient 2 is seeded: SQLCODE 0, CA-RETURN-CODE '00'

scenarios.name: found-bp-only
scenarios.why: patient 3 has a BLOODPRESSURE row but no HEARTRATE row: GET-BLOODPRESSURE '00', GET-HEARTRATE SQLCODE 100 sets '01'

scenarios.name: not-found
scenarios.why: no BLOODPRESSURE row for patient 9: SQLCODE 100, CA-RETURN-CODE '01', RETURN

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE (LINK HCAZERRS) then ABEND HCCA

scenarios.name: short-commarea
scenarios.why: one byte under the 18-byte header: '98' to CA-RETURN-CODE, RETURN before any SELECT

scenarios.name: short-time
scenarios.why: CA-VISIT-TIME(10:) is spaces: '.0' is moved into positions 9-10 (the program edits the commarea), so the key is 10:30:15.0 and the seeded row still matches

scenarios.name: bloodpressure-select-deadlock-913
scenarios.why: the BLOODPRESSURE SELECT meets a Db2 timeout (-913): '01' in CA-RETURN-CODE and the program carries on

scenarios.name: bloodpressure-select-fails-904
scenarios.why: the BLOODPRESSURE SELECT meets resource unavailable (-904): WHEN OTHER sets '90', writes the error message and RETURNs

scenarios.name: heartrate-select-deadlock-913
scenarios.why: the HEARTRATE SELECT meets a Db2 timeout (-913): '01' in CA-RETURN-CODE and the program carries on

scenarios.name: heartrate-select-fails-904
scenarios.why: the HEARTRATE SELECT meets resource unavailable (-904): WHEN OTHER sets '90', writes the error message and RETURNs
